name: Pokémon Spaceless Pearl
summary:
Pokémon Spaceless Pearl is an unofficial expansion hack of Pokémon Pearl Version. It was released alongside Pokémon Timeless Diamond, which is a mod of Pokémon Diamond Version.

“What would Pokémon Diamond and Pearl look like if their development had taken a year longer?”

This thought experiment laid the groundwork for an exciting modding project in the fall of 2023. The focus was on creating an enhanced experience of the original Sinnoh games by incorporating ideas from Pokémon Platinum Version and modern Pokémon games without straying from the artistic vision behind Diamond and Pearl.
